verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's feature 'rules' (targeting conditions, percentage rollouts, scheduling, experiment assignment) automatically apply different treatments to users based on attributes, and stale-flag detection runs automatically — a form of rule-driven automation. However, this is scoped to flag targeting/rollout logic, not general event-triggered actions (e.g., webhooks firing on experiment completion, external notifications, or arbitrary system events), which are not evidenced. Missing for 10: documented webhook/event-trigger system, evidence of arbitrary external actions firing on events, and independent corroboration of automation beyond flag targeting.
